content: Godaa Keeththafe Xoossa Bonchcho Shaaketeth
Tani xeelliza wode simpere geetettiza inqqufe oosettida araata misatizay kirubeta hu7e bolla salo mala micetti diza miish be7adis.

GODAY layno may7ida addeza, «Kirubetappe garsa baggara irzota giddora kanththada ba; histtada tama bonqo ne kushen kuphphata ekkada, katamay bolla laalla» gides. Ta xeellishin addezi tamaa ekkanaas gelides.
Addezi giddo geliza wode kirubeti Xoossa Keeththafe dugeha baggara eqqida; giddo zagozakka shaaray kumides.
GODAA bonchchoy kirubeta bollafe dendidi Xoossa Keeththaa darmach biidi eqqides. GODAA keeththaa shaaray kumides; zagozi phoolliza GODAA bonchchon kumides.
Kirubeta qefeta giirissay Ubbaa Dandayza Xoossay haasayshin siyettiza cenggurssa mala kare zagon siyettees.
GODAY layno may7ida addeza, «Kirubeta matappe irzota giddofe tama ekka» giidi azaziin, izi gelidi irzotappe issaa achchan eqqides.
Kirubetappe issoy bantta giddon diza tamaakko ba kusheza yeddidi, izappe guuth ekkidi, layno may7ida addeza kushen woththiin izikka ekkidi kezides.
Kirubeta qefeppe garsa baggara asa kushe misatizaazi beettees.
Tani xeelliza wode kirubeta milleson oyddu irzoti deettes; issi issi kirube millen issi issi irzoy dizayssa be7adis; he irzoti inqqu mala phoolleettes.
Istti oyddayka issoy issaa misateettes; issi issi irzoy hara irzora issife oyketti oosettidaa misatees.

Irzoti baana dendiza wode kirubeti baanaas simmidi oyddu bagga baanaas dandayeettes; kirubeti biza wode irzoti yaanne haa gontta sitti gi beettes. Kirubeti biza wode irzoti yaanne haa gontta hu7ey simmida awa baggaka beettes.
Istta kumeththa bollan, istta zokkon, istta kushen, istta qefetaninne oyddu irzota ubbaan ayfey kumides.
Irzoti, «Edzdzotiza irzota» geetetti xeygettishin ta siyadis.
Issi issi kirubes oyddu ayfesoy dees. Koyroyssi kirube ayfeso, nam7anththozi asa ayfeso, heedzdzanththozi gaammo ayfesonne oydanththozi golle ayfeso misatees.
Hessafe guye kirubeti pude dendida. Heytikka tani Koboore shaafa matan be7ida shemppora paxa diza medheteththata.
Qasse kirubeti baana qaaxxiza wode istta millen diza irzotikka qaaxxeettes; kirubeti biittafe pude dendanawu bantta qefeta yangiza wodekka istta millen diza irzotikka isttafe shaakettettenna.

Kirubeti sitti gi eqqiza wode irzotikka eqqaa geettes; kirubeti biittafe pude dhoqqu gi dendiza wode irzota giddon shemppora paxa diza medheteththata ayanay diza gishshas irzotikka isttara issife dendeettes.
Hessafe guye GODAA bonchchoy Xoossa Keeththa darmachchafe dendidi kirubeta bolla eqqides.

Tani xeellishin kirubeti bantta qefeta yangidi irzotarakka issife biittafe pude dendi bida. Istti arshey mokkiza baggara diza GODAA keeththa yuushon diza gimbe pengen eqqida; Isra7eele Xoossa bonchchoyka isttafe bollara dees.
Hayti Koboore Shaafan Isra7eele Xoossaa garsan ta be7ida shemppora paxa diza medheteththata; isttika kirubeta gididayssa ta akeekadis.
Isttas issaas issaaskka oyddu ayfesoynne oyddu qefey dees; istta qefetappe garsa baggara asa kushe misatizaazi dees.
Istta ayfesoykka Koboore Shaafa matan ta be7idayta misatees. Istti issoy issoy sitti giidi sinth beettes.

footnotes.text: Kirube gizayssa issi issi geeshsha maxaafan boora geetettees
